subject: Mystery holes
topic: Something made these holes on the seafloor, and nobody knows what.
script:
Something made these holes on the seafloor, and nobody knows what.
NOAA found them about two and a half kilometers down, in the North Atlantic.
They run in neat lines, almost like dotted lines drawn in the mud.
Later, the team saw more of them, at four more sites on another dive.
So the robot used a suction tool to collect mud from some of the freshest holes.
Back on the ship, the sediment revealed no clues.
The team also collected water, to search for DNA from whatever lives around the holes.
Was it an animal digging? Something feeding? The mystery is still open.
What do you think made them?
pkg_title: Nobody Knows What Made These Holes in the Seafloor 🕳️ #Shorts
